en: Color illustration of a group of five people in traditional regional dress gathered indoors around a table in front of a large green tiled stove. Three young women wear tall orange cylindrical hats and dirndl-style dresses; an older woman in darker clothing and bonnet sits to the left, and a man in a black suit and hat sits at the table. The scene is bordered by a gray mount with handwritten German text beneath the image.
